verdict.rationale: Logseq offers a `logseq://x-callback-url/quickCapture` protocol that can be bookmarked in a browser for quick capture of short text and links, but this is not an official full-featured web clipper capable of capturing entire articles or highlights — it's limited to short text/link capture via a manual bookmarklet or CLI. Missing for 10: an official browser extension/clipper, evidence of capturing full article content or highlighted text, and any first-party or community confirmation of a dedicated clipping tool beyond the quickCapture protocol.
